identity.name: Release integrity review
identity.description: Focused release-chain review of dependency locks, package provenance, automation permissions, and publisher configuration.

rules.label: Dependency lock file changed
rules.check: Compare dependency graph changes, new transitive packages, and integrity metadata.

rules.label: Install or publish lifecycle hook changed
rules.check: Review executable lifecycle hooks and demonstrate expected behavior in a clean environment.

rules.label: Publishing workflow changed
rules.check: Review least-privilege token permissions, trigger trust boundaries, and publish provenance.

rules.label: Registry or publisher configuration changed
rules.check: Inspect registry targets and publish access settings without disclosing credentials.

protectedPaths.reason: Changes to release workflows and token permissions must satisfy automated security and provenance checks.
A lockfile change can introduce additional executable dependencies.

requiredChecks.reason: Run a repeatable dependency vulnerability audit and record unresolved advisories.
Inspect the exact npm artifact contents before publication; do not publish automatically.
